fixedRules: Day 50 is the default terminal deadline and Day 51 is unreachable.
A fulfilled escape completes immediately on any day and outranks Day 50 settlement.
Only completed eligible searches in a listed primary or alternative region increment key-part pity.
Every softlock audit point retains at least three completable escape method IDs.
A major hazard reserves the next day recovery budget and forbids a same-family new major.
Protected key parts and completed escape stages survive theft, damage, retry and recovery.
Smoke and radio use distinct direct world interactions and never a shared global completion shortcut.
Ending priority, tie-break and hysteresis prevent one final two-point action from replacing an established identity.
Structured logs contain no name, account, IP, device ID, raw input, position trace or free text.

commonProbeContract.publicProbeIdRule: Use the exact existing W17 gate ID; no synonym probe IDs.
commonProbeContract.determinism: Same runSeed, day, world state and input produce the same stable-ID ordered result.

gateItems.playerContract: Show the current one of five day bands; Day 49 settlement continues to Day 50 and Day 50 settlement terminates without Day 51.

publicContract.expected: Exact start/end enumeration, day49=continue, day50=day50_settlement, day51 unreachable.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Use real settlement input on a fresh run to continue Day 49 and terminate Day 50.
gateItems.atomicity: Band lookup is read-only; failed or cancelled settlement changes nothing; retry cannot increment the day twice.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.pacing.day-band; log pacing.band.entered with day, pacingBandId and resultCode.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Band boundaries and Day 50 terminal are fixed; per-band hazard budgets and forecast modifiers remain SAMPLE_ONLY.

gateItems.playerContract: A player with a fulfilled escape project can complete it immediately on any day through the project interaction.

publicContract.expected: escape_complete on every boundary and escape priority over day50_settlement.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Complete smoke and radio requirements through fresh no-grant no-warp routes and invoke their real completion interactions.
gateItems.atomicity: Cancel or failure preserves costs, stages and terminal state; retry returns the same ending without duplicate spend, log or panel unlock.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.escape.ready; log escape.completed with escapeMethodId, day and resultCode=escape_complete.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Preparation time and costs remain SAMPLE_ONLY; no date hard lock on a fulfilled escape is fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: Preview all three starting and three expansion regions; each locked expansion region shows one prioritized lock reason and an alternate route.

publicContract.expected: Exactly six profiles; either independent route unlocks the same region and unresolved state returns one lockReasonCode.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Unlock one primary and one alternative expansion route through actual return, research, equipment and discovery state without a recommended-band date gate.
gateItems.atomicity: Preview and cancel change nothing; confirm writes one regionUnlockId; failure and retry cannot duplicate reward or score.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.region.lock-reason; log region.previewed/unlocked with regionId, unlockRouteId and lockReasonCode.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Requirement counts, travel bands and forecast shifts remain SAMPLE_ONLY; six IDs, two independent routes and no day hard gate are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: The same seed, day and committed state preserve map forecast, hazard forecast, unlock and pity clue across reload.

publicContract.expected: Same seed produces identical ordered forecastIds, hazardIds, unlockIds, pityCounters and hash; another seed remains inside catalogs and invariants.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Run map-search-return on two fresh saves with the same seed and actions, then one valid different seed.
gateItems.atomicity: Read probe, preview, locale/input switch and reload do not consume RNG; only a committed event advances its declared stream once.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: KO and EN show identical abundance, risk and lock meaning; log only runSeed, day, stable IDs and result codes.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Probabilities, abundance shifts and hazard frequency remain SAMPLE_ONLY; deterministic inputs and catalog bounds are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: After three missing eligible searches the player sees a source clue; after five misses the next eligible result grants the missing protected part.

publicContract.expected: Only completed eligible increments; hint at 3; after miss 5 the next eligible places the part before optional loot.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Select, search and return from listed primary or alternative regions through real interactions; date and noneligible repeats cannot create the hint or guarantee.
gateItems.atomicity: Cancel, fail, unrelated and duplicate keep the counter and loot unchanged; guarantee commits with inventory capacity or not at all and retry cannot duplicate the part.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.key-part.pity-hint; log keyPartId, eligibleSearchCount and sourceRegionId on hint/guarantee events.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Thresholds 3 and 5 remain SAMPLE_ONLY; eligibility semantics, part-first guarantee and non-counted cases are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: The player chooses one route, but a seed cannot reduce technically completable escape routes below three; audit internals remain hidden.

publicContract.expected: At every audit point return at least three stable-ID-sorted completableEscapeIds.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Capture actual fresh-run state at all four audit points and distinguish route refusal from technical softlock.
gateItems.atomicity: Audit read is immutable; repair rerolls only unowned key-part placement atomically before exposure or inside unlock, preserving resources, actions and owned parts; retry is identical.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Do not expose hidden placement; log auditPoint, resultCode and completableEscapeIds without free text.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Four audit points and minimum three are fixed; which unowned placement is rerolled and its probability remain SAMPLE_ONLY.

gateItems.playerContract: The player receives a calm opportunity in every rolling five days and a visible recovery choice on the day after a major hazard.

publicContract.expected: Every rolling five-day window has a calm day; the day after major reserves recovery budget 2 and forbids same-family new major; Day 50 arms no surprise theft/damage.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Execute at least ten natural settlements including telegraph, major resolution and next-day recovery; hunger and existing recovery continue on calm days.
gateItems.atomicity: Schedule preview is immutable; one day key arms once; cancelled pre-arm is unchanged; unused recovery budget cannot arm another major; retry cannot reserve twice.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.hazard.telegraph/recovery; log hazard ID, family, budget and result on calm, telegraph and recovery events.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Window 5, budget 2 and band budgets remain SAMPLE_ONLY; telegraph, reserved recovery, same-family ban and Day50 surprise ban are fixed fairness rules.

gateItems.playerContract: The player sees one explained theft or damage loss and never loses a protected key part or completed escape stage.

publicContract.expected: First call changes one allowed target; second returns already_resolved; protected parts, completed stages, score and additional log remain unchanged.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Execute telegraphed, armed, resolved, recovering and recovered through real camp interactions with one mitigated and one unmitigated case.
gateItems.atomicity: Resource/facility/hazard/score/log commit together or roll back; retry, locale and input switch cannot duplicate loss, repair or event.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: KO/EN state the same cause and protection result; log hazardInstanceId, targetId, lossCode and resultCode only.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Loss quantity and recovery cost remain SAMPLE_ONLY; single loss, idempotency and protected part/stage preservation are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: Smoke uses direct fuel, ignition and smoke-maintenance interaction while radio uses direct power, tuning and transmit interaction; no shared global completion shortcut.

publicContract.expected: Each separate route reports unique interactionIds, actualInteractionCount greater than zero, grant=false, warp=false and terminalResult=escape_complete.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Run two separate fresh 30-minute fixtures through movement, map, search, return and world project interactions.
gateItems.atomicity: Preview, cancel and failure preserve cost and stage; each milestone commits once; one route failure cannot erase another route stage.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.escape.project-action; log escapeMethodId, interactionId, milestoneId, resultCode, grantUsed=false and warpUsed=false.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Cost, duration and hazard intensity remain SAMPLE_ONLY; route-distinct direct interactions and no-debug completion are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: Do not expose raft, flare or beacon as playable-ready in this transition; validate their data and resolver only.

publicContract.expected: All references validate, playableState=data-only, and sample result transactions preserve unrelated completed stages and protected parts.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: No human or playable natural-route PASS is allowed; catalog and deterministic snapshots use the same campaign stable IDs only.
gateItems.atomicity: Validator is read-only; sample success, delay or failure mutates only declared result fields once and preserves unrelated progress.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Prepare equivalent KO/EN catalog meaning but expose no playable CTA; log escapeMethodId, playableState=data-only and resultCode.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: All costs, durations and probabilities remain SAMPLE_ONLY; three IDs and data-only evidence boundary are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: Save and resume preserve region, hazard, project and behavior state without asking for personal information.

publicContract.expected: Round-trip preserves all stable states and privacy scan finds zero forbidden fields.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Save and resume a fresh run, then perform the next real interaction with the same deterministic result; gameplay remains usable if development logging fails.
gateItems.atomicity: Snapshot uses atomic replacement and preserves the prior copy on failure; an event idempotency key appends once and never reapplies gameplay state.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: KO/EN display the same stable state; only the common allowlist is serialized and all forbidden privacy fields are absent.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Snapshot and privacy schemas are not balance; logging frequency and elapsed values cannot promote SAMPLE_ONLY tuning.

gateItems.playerContract: Early escape outranks Day 50 settlement and the ending explains the established lifestyle without a last-button identity flip.

publicContract.expected: Identical ending, reason and identity; escape priority; tie-break keep-established then established-day then stat-ID ASCII; challenger plus two cannot switch identity.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Create smoke/radio and Day50 terminal snapshots from real accumulated actions without debug score grants.
gateItems.atomicity: Resolver is pure; reopen, cancel or locale switch changes no ending or score; gallery unlock commits once per ending ID.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Display ui.ending.reason; log stat ID, ending ID and reasonCode only on identity and ending events.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Action 1-2, cap 4, candidate 12, lead 4 and switch 6 remain SAMPLE_ONLY; priority, tie-break order and no one-action reversal are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: In Play state the player sees and acts through telegraph, occurrence, mitigation and recovery for injury, disaster and food theft.

publicContract.expected: Each hazard records four phases, unique hazardInstanceId, active surface ID and deterministic transition results; reflection-only is not PASS.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Use actual Play interactions once per hazard in automated natural fixtures; keep this evidence separate from six unrun human sessions.
gateItems.atomicity: Failed or cancelled phase is unchanged; same instance adds no loss; recovered retry returns already_recovered.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: KO/EN preserve cause and response meaning at every phase; only structured events are logged.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Occurrence rate, damage and recovery cost remain SAMPLE_ONLY; four phases, live surface and idempotency are fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: In Play state the player walks to distinct smoke and radio facilities and completes each through its real interaction sequence.

publicContract.expected: Separate interaction traces, actualInteractionCount greater than zero, grantCount=0, warpCount=0 and matching terminal escape ID.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Use two fresh saves and only actual movement, map, search, return and facility input; one probe completing both methods is a failure.
gateItems.atomicity: Failed or cancelled interaction preserves stage and cost; retry commits once; terminal replay cannot consume again or select another ending.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Method CTAs have the same KO/EN action meaning; log E02 fields without raw input.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Time and costs remain SAMPLE_ONLY; distinct live natural interaction evidence is fixed.

gateItems.playerContract: After early escape or Day 50 resolution the player sees exactly three core comic roles: setup, escalation and punchline.

publicContract.expected: Correct terminal priority and existing ending ID with exactly three active panelRoleCodes in stable order; no new content ID.

gateItems.naturalAcceptance: Reach at least one smoke, radio or Day50 terminal through real accumulated actions; validate remaining sample snapshots deterministically.
gateItems.atomicity: Close, reopen and locale switch preserve terminal, score and unlock; reload restores the same three-panel order without duplicate unlock.
gateItems.koEnOrLog: Use existing ending KO/EN title/body keys plus ui.ending.reason; log endingId, panelRoleCode, panelIndex and resultCode.
gateItems.sampleBoundary: Final art, animation and copy length remain unadopted or tunable; exactly three core roles and terminal priority are fixed smoke-contract behavior, not new endings.

implementationOrder.goal: Publish pacing, region, seed, pity and softlock data plus pure deterministic probes.
Connect fair cadence and protected atomic hazard transactions.
Complete route-distinct projects, data-only validators, snapshot privacy and terminal identity.
Drive the same public semantics through actual Play interactions and presentation.

greenAcceptance: Exactly the fifteen declared W17 gate IDs pass on a fresh post-implementation SHA with no expected gap or failure.
Wave 15 and Wave 16 remain GREEN and compile, Windows build, hidden smoke, qps-long and Addressables infrastructure remain PASS.
All deterministic probes are stable on repeat and all natural routes record grant, warp and skip as zero.
Eligible-only pity, four minimum-three softlock audits, calm/recovery reservation, key-part protection, distinct smoke/radio interactions, ending hysteresis and privacy allowlist pass independently.
Raft, flare and beacon remain data-only and are not claimed as playable PASS.
Six first-user sessions remain UNRUN; physical gamepad and Steam remain UNVERIFIED.

verticalSlice.goal: 실제 기본 데드라인이 Day 50인 빌드에서 김씨가 캠프 지도 오브젝트를 직접 사용해 서로 다른 세 수집 지역 중 하나를 고르고, 표시된 자원·위험 정보에 맞춰 준비·수색·귀환한 뒤 예고 가능한 위험 하나를 완화하고 서로 다른 두 탈출 프로젝트 중 하나를 진전시키며, 행동 통계가 엔딩 판정 입력으로 누적되는 30분 이내의 대표 루프를 검증한다.

tasks.title: Wave 18 15개 FAIL GREEN 전환 계약
tasks.description: Wave 17 통합 FAIL 15개를 기존 게이트 ID별 플레이어 행동, 공개 결정론 probe, 자연 경로, 원자성, KO/EN·privacy 로그와 SAMPLE_ONLY 경계에 1:1 매핑한다.
acceptanceCriteria: 지정 15개 W17 gate가 중복·누락 없이 각각 여섯 계약 축에 1:1 매핑된다.
Day band 비잠금, eligible-only pity, 최소 3경로, 평온일·회복 예약, 핵심 부품 보호, smoke/radio 분리, hysteresis와 privacy가 명시된다.
Wave 15/16 카탈로그와 SAMPLE_ONLY 수치가 변경·승격되지 않고 인간 6세션은 UNRUN이다.

tasks.title: Wave 18 15개 제품 FAIL GREEN 전환 구현
tasks.description: Wave 18 계약의 기존 15개 W17 gate 공개 데이터·결정론 probe·자연 상호작용·원자 transaction·privacy 로그를 구현한다. 새 콘텐츠나 최종 밸런스 승격은 하지 않는다.
acceptanceCriteria: 지정 15개 gate의 공개 데이터와 semantic probe가 문서의 안정 ID·입출력·원자성 계약을 그대로 제공한다.
smoke/radio는 별도 실제 상호작용이며 raft/flare/beacon은 data-only를 유지한다.
자연 route는 grant/warp/skip 0이고 로그 allowlist 밖 개인정보·자유 입력이 없다.
Wave 15/16 GREEN과 SAMPLE_ONLY 값을 되돌리거나 정식 값으로 승격하지 않는다.

tasks.title: Wave 18 GREEN 전환 통합 검증
tasks.description: 새 구현 SHA에서 Wave 17 게이트를 fresh 실행해 지정 15개 PASS, Wave 15/16 GREEN과 인프라 PASS 보존, 인간 6세션 UNRUN 경계를 검증한다.
acceptanceCriteria: 지정 15개 gate의 EXPECTED_GAP/FAIL이 0이고 같은 seed 반복 결과가 결정론적이다.
P01–P03은 실제 Play 증거를 가지며 Edit-only PASS로 대체되지 않는다.
Wave 15/16 GREEN, qps-long, compile, Windows build, hidden smoke와 Addressables PASS가 보존된다.
인간 6세션, 물리 게임패드와 Steam을 실행 증거 없이 PASS 처리하지 않는다.

decisions.summary: 지정된 기존 W17 gate ID 15개를 공개 probe ID로 그대로 사용하고 동의어를 만들지 않는다.
decisions.rationale: 구현·QA·통합 보고서 사이의 1:1 추적성을 보존하고 파일명·reflection 기반 허위 PASS를 막는다.

decisions.summary: 결정론 fixture, 실제 Play 자연 경로, 인간 플레이테스트를 별도 증거 등급으로 유지하며 grant·warp·skip 없는 경로만 자연 경로로 센다.
decisions.rationale: semantic probe 성공을 실제 플레이 경험이나 미실행 사용자 결과로 오인하지 않기 위함이다.

decisions.summary: Wave 16의 위험 예산, pity 3/5, 준비 기간과 행동 임계값은 구현 smoke 값으로만 유지하고 E3 전 최종 밸런스로 승격하지 않는다.
decisions.rationale: 이번 작업은 누락된 제품 계약을 GREEN으로 전환하는 작업이며 새로운 밸런스 증거를 만들지 않는다.

decisions.summary: Wave 17의 ko 3/en 3 첫 사용자 자연 50일 세션은 구현·자동 게이트 GREEN 이후에도 별도 실행 전까지 UNRUN이다.
decisions.rationale: 자동화 결과와 실제 사용자 관찰을 섞거나 수행하지 않은 결과를 꾸며내지 않는다.
